title: UP Anganwadi Worker Bharti Recruitment 2026 Apply Online District Wise Vacancy Details
vacancyDetails: Current district-wise Anganwadi Worker vacancies: Gonda 128, Jalaun 18, Gautam Buddha Nagar 84, Amethi 172, Amroha 105, Balrampur 236, Hamirpur 80, Fatehpur 239, Banda 122 and Azamgarh 66; total listed vacancies 1,250.
qualification: Only female candidates who have passed 10+2 Intermediate from a recognized board and are residents of the relevant village, ward or Nyaya Panchayat may apply, subject to the district notice.
ageLimit: 18 to 35 years; age relaxation applies as per Uttar Pradesh Anganwadi Worker recruitment rules.
applicationFee: Nil for all categories. No application fee is charged.
selectionProcess: Merit based on educational marks / local criteria → Document Verification → Appointment
documentsRequired: 12th marksheet, residence proof, photo ID, passport photos, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upanganwadibharti.in/workernew/users/registration.php
2. Register or log in to the UP Anganwadi portal
3. Select the district and Anganwadi Worker post
4. Fill the form, upload documents and submit it before the district deadline
5. Save the final application and track the district merit list
statusNote: District-wise applications are active; last dates differ by district
shortDescription: UP Anganwadi Worker Bharti Recruitment 2026 is open district-wise for 1,250 listed vacancies. Check district vacancies, last dates, eligibility and apply online at upanganwadibharti.in.
content:
Integrated Child Development Services Scheme (ICDS) has released district-wise notifications for UP Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026. The current listed districts include Gonda, Jalaun, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Amethi, Amroha, Balrampur, Hamirpur, Fatehpur, Banda and Azamgarh.

There are 1,250 vacancies in the listed districts. Applications are accepted district-wise, so candidates must check the individual notice for the village, ward or Nyaya Panchayat vacancy and final deadline.

District-wise vacancy and last date

  • Gonda: 128 posts, last date 02/10/2026
  • Jalaun: 18 posts, last date 30/09/2026
  • Gautam Buddha Nagar: 84 posts, last date 28/09/2026
  • Amethi: 172 posts, last date 21/09/2026
  • Amroha: 105 posts, last date 24/09/2026
  • Balrampur: 236 posts, last date 23/09/2026
  • Hamirpur: 80 posts, last date 16/09/2026
  • Fatehpur: 239 posts, last date 17/09/2026
  • Banda: 122 posts, last date 22/09/2026
  • Azamgarh: 66 posts, last date 14/09/2026

Eligibility

Only female candidates who have passed Intermediate and are residents of the relevant village, ward or Nyaya Panchayat may apply. The age limit is 18 to 35 years and the application fee is Nil for all candidates. Read the district notice before submitting the online form.
